title: Moonwarden — Solo-built multiplayer web game about cute slimes and betrayal. Looking for honest beta feedback!
author: National_Cut_7565
selftext:
Hey everyone! I’m a solo dev building **Moonwarden**, a free browser-based multiplayer game set in a magical forest with cute slimes and friends you probably shouldn’t trust.

I just pushed a live multiplayer beta and need players to help me stress-test it. Bugs and rough edges are expected! Right now, my main goal is figuring out if the core gameplay loop feels intuitive and fun, or where it falls flat.

Since it runs directly in the browser, there’s nothing to download.

* **Play the Beta:**[https://moonwarden-two.vercel.app/](https://moonwarden-two.vercel.app/)
* **Feedback Form:** [\[Insert Google Form Link\]](https://docs.google.com/forms/d/1w5tvAa2DykM4CWy7kUpVOpYmm7OGlPlj_eCdIM979ts) *(or just drop your thoughts in the comments!)*

**AI Workflow / Disclosure:**

* **Code:** Built with substantial AI coding assistance to get the multiplayer logic and frontend up and running solo.
* **Audio:** Soundtrack generated using AI to match the magical forest vibe.

Any feedback on gameplay, pacing, or bugs you run into would help me out a ton. Thanks for checking it out!
